title: 영화 시리즈의 평가 순위와 이름 연결
description: Number in Series를 /로 나눠 Film Order와 Total Films in Series를 정수로 만듭니다. Trilogy Grouping별 Rating의 반올림 전 평균과 최댓값을 계산하고 평균 내림차순, 최댓값 내림차순, 그룹 ID 오름차순으로 순위를 매깁니다. 순위는 1부터 연속입니다. # Step 1: 시리즈 위치와 점수 정리
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

films = input_df.copy()
trilogies = tables['table_2'].copy()

# Split the series position into numeric film order and series length.
series_parts = films["Number in Series"].str.split("/", expand=True)
films["Film Order"] = series_parts[0].astype(int)
films["Total Films in Series"] = series_parts[1].astype(int)
films["Rating"] = films["Rating"].astype(float)

# Step 2: 그룹 집계와 동률 순위 계산
# Rank anonymous groups by their unrounded mean, then their highest rating.
group_stats = films.groupby("Trilogy Grouping")["Rating"].agg(
    average="mean", highest="max"
).reset_index()
group_stats = group_stats.sort_values(
    ["average", "highest", "Trilogy Grouping"],
    ascending=[False, False, True],
    kind="mergesort",
).reset_index(drop=True)
group_stats["Trilogy Ranking"] = (group_stats.index + 1).astype(str)
group_stats["Trilogy Average"] = group_stats["average"].round(1).map(lambda value: f"{value:.1f}")

# Step 3: 이름 정제와 두 번의 조인
# Clean the names and join them to the computed ranking.
trilogies["Trilogy"] = trilogies["Trilogy"].str.replace(r"\s+trilogy\s*$", "", regex=True)
trilogies["Trilogy Ranking"] = trilogies["Trilogy Ranking"].astype(str)
ranked_groups = group_stats[["Trilogy Grouping", "Trilogy Ranking", "Trilogy Average"]]
film_rows = films.merge(ranked_groups, on="Trilogy Grouping", how="inner")
result = film_rows.merge(trilogies, on="Trilogy Ranking", how="inner")

# Step 4: 수치 형식과 다중 키 정렬
# Format numeric-derived output fields as strings, then order and select columns.
result["Film Order"] = result["Film Order"].astype(str)
result["Total Films in Series"] = result["Total Films in Series"].astype(str)
result["Rating"] = result["Rating"].map(lambda value: f"{value:.1f}")
result = result.sort_values(
    ["Trilogy Ranking", "Film Order", "Title"],
    key=lambda column: column.astype(int) if column.name in ["Trilogy Ranking", "Film Order"] else column,
    kind="mergesort",
).reset_index(drop=True)
result = result[[
    "Trilogy Ranking", "Trilogy", "Trilogy Average", "Film Order",
    "Title", "Rating", "Total Films in Series"
]]

for numeric_column in ['Trilogy Ranking', 'Trilogy Average', 'Film Order', 'Rating', 'Total Films in Series']:
    result[numeric_column] = pd.to_numeric(result[numeric_column], errors='coerce')
